result:
`./out/book.pdf` is an 8-page A4 landscape portfolio with a warm paper ground and a brick-red accent, set in a serif for headlines and a small sans for captions. It uses all 11 images and drawings, none cropped or stretched. I checked the render at low resolution only, not a print proof.

The pages run in this order:
- **Cover:** a brick-red spine, a large "Robie House" title and the south photo.
- **Concept:** a headline column beside a large interior photo, with the street photo and a caption below it.
- **Plans, two sheets:** ground and main-floor plans side by side.
- **Plans, one sheet:** the third-floor plan large, with text to its right.
- **Section:** the section and south elevation sheet, with a narrow text column.
- **Elevations:** the west/east/north elevations beside the fireplace elevations, offset on the page.
- **Glass:** the two window sheets side by side.
- **Survey:** the HABS credits and an index of thumbnails of all eight sheets.

The three photos are only 564–834 px wide, so they will look soft at the sizes used. All text comes from project.md; the page titles and captions are my wording, built from project.md and the sheet titles.
